title: The Fast Trick to Divide by 5
description: Doubling a number and shifting the decimal point instead of dividing by 5 directly.
narration_lines: Here's a fast way to divide by 5. What's 84 divided by 5?
Now just move the decimal point one place left.

steps.label: Move the decimal one place left

params.footnote: dividing by 5 is always ×2 then shift the decimal
